request: open the af model for the gene adrb2

request: color it like a rainbow

request: make it white

request: color by chain
expected: Starting from an all-white 4hhb, each of the four chains gets its own distinct ribbon color.

request: color resdue 159 in blue please
expected: Residue 159 is blue on its cartoon segment and/or its atoms; the rest of the protein is untouched.
check: ((atoms.filter((atoms.residues.numbers == 159) & (atoms.structure_categories == 'main')).residues.ribbon_colors[:, 2] > 150).all() and (atoms.filter((atoms.residues.numbers == 159) & (atoms.structure_categories == 'main')).residues.ribbon_colors[:, 0] < 100).all()) or ((atoms.filter((atoms.residues.numbers == 159) & (atoms.structure_categories == 'main')).colors[:, 2] > 150).all() and (atoms.filter((atoms.residues.numbers == 159) & (atoms.structure_categories == 'main')).colors[:, 0] < 100).all())

request: select aas 159 and 300
expected: Residues 159 and 300 are selected first; after 'reverse selection' everything except those two residues is selected.
check: len(sel_res) > 200 and 159 not in sel_res and 300 not in sel_res

request: select postions 159 and 300 and color them green. the rest of the protein should be white
expected: Residues 159 and 300 end up selected and green (atoms and/or cartoon) while the rest of the protein cartoon is white; the whole thing is done in one turn without asking.
check: set(sel_res) == {159, 300} and (((atoms.filter((atoms.residues.numbers == 159) & (atoms.structure_categories == 'main')).colors[:, 1] > 100).all() and (atoms.filter((atoms.residues.numbers == 159) & (atoms.structure_categories == 'main')).colors[:, 0] < 100).all()) or ((atoms.filter((atoms.residues.numbers == 159) & (atoms.structure_categories == 'main')).residues.ribbon_colors[:, 1] > 100).all() and (atoms.filter((atoms.residues.numbers == 159) & (atoms.structure_categories == 'main')).residues.ribbon_colors[:, 0] < 100).all())) and (atoms.filter((atoms.residues.numbers == 50) & (atoms.structure_categories == 'main')).residues.ribbon_colors[:, :3] > 225).all()

request: show it's atoms
expected: 'it' resolves to the currently selected residue 159 and all of its atoms become displayed.

request: hide all the atoms i only want the cartoon
expected: Every protein atom is hidden and the cartoon stays visible.
check: not atoms.filter(atoms.structure_categories == 'main').displays.any() and atoms.residues.ribbon_displays.any()

request: show the ligand as spheres and hide the water
expected: The heme (and phosphate) ligand atoms are displayed in sphere style and all water atoms are hidden, in a single run_commands call.
check: atoms.filter(atoms.structure_categories == 'ligand').displays.all() and (atoms.filter(atoms.structure_categories == 'ligand').draw_modes == 0).all() and not atoms.filter(atoms.structure_categories == 'solvent').displays.any()

request: select amono acids 100 and 150 and mesure the distance between them
expected: A distance monitor (pseudobond in the 'distances' group) is created between an atom of residue 100 and an atom of residue 150, typically the CA atoms.
check: session.pb_manager.get_group('distances', create=False) is not None and any({a.residue.number for a in pb.atoms} == {100, 150} for pb in session.pb_manager.get_group('distances', create=False).pseudobonds)

request: color the entire protein white, after that select amino acids 160 and 300 - color these red and show their atoms. also, mesure the distance between these two
expected: In one turn: the protein cartoon is white, residues 160 and 300 are selected, their atoms are shown and red, and a distance monitor exists between them.
check: set(sel_res) == {160, 300} and atoms.filter(((atoms.residues.numbers == 160) | (atoms.residues.numbers == 300)) & (atoms.structure_categories == 'main')).displays.all() and (atoms.filter(((atoms.residues.numbers == 160) | (atoms.residues.numbers == 300)) & (atoms.structure_categories == 'main')).colors[:, 0] > 180).all() and (atoms.filter(((atoms.residues.numbers == 160) | (atoms.residues.numbers == 300)) & (atoms.structure_categories == 'main')).colors[:, 1] < 100).all() and (atoms.filter((atoms.residues.numbers == 50) & (atoms.structure_categories == 'main')).residues.ribbon_colors[:, :3] > 225).all() and session.pb_manager.get_group('distances', create=False) is not None and any({a.residue.number for a in pb.atoms} == {160, 300} for pb in session.pb_manager.get_group('distances', create=False).pseudobonds)

request: make it spin
expected: A continuous rotation (roll) is started and is still in progress when the turn ends.
check: bool(getattr(session, 'motion_in_progress', None))

request: spin the view slowly
expected: The view rolls slowly, 'slower' restarts it with a smaller step, and after 'stop the spinning' no motion remains in progress: the Chimaera holds position.
check: not getattr(session, 'motion_in_progress', None) and any(c.strip().lower().startswith(('roll', 'turn')) for c in ran)

request: i want to focuse the view on 159
expected: The camera moves in close on residue 159 (view #1:159), so the camera is within ~70 A of that residue instead of ~150 A away as in the whole-protein view.
check: (((session.main_view.camera.position.origin() - atoms.filter((atoms.residues.numbers == 159) & (atoms.structure_categories == 'main')).scene_coords.mean(axis=0)) ** 2).sum() ** 0.5) < 70

request: focus on these two amino acids
expected: 'these two' resolves to the selected residues 159-160 and the camera zooms in on them (view sel).
check: (((session.main_view.camera.position.origin() - atoms.filter(((atoms.residues.numbers == 159) | (atoms.residues.numbers == 160)) & (atoms.structure_categories == 'main')).scene_coords.mean(axis=0)) ** 2).sum() ** 0.5) < 70

request: tuen the bacground black
expected: Despite two typos the background is set to black.
check: all(c < 0.1 for c in bg)

request: color the background grey
expected: The background becomes a neutral mid-grey (set bgColor gray).

request: put labels on aa 159 and 300
expected: 3D labels are attached to residues 159 and 300 (an ObjectLabels model with at least two labels).
check: sum(len(m.labels()) for m in models if m.__class__.__name__ == 'ObjectLabels') >= 2

request: make the selected half transperent
expected: The selected residues 1-100 become about 50% transparent on their cartoon, atoms and/or surface (transparency sel 50 with a target).
check: (atoms.filter(atoms.residues.numbers <= 100).residues.ribbon_colors[:, 3] < 200).any() or (atoms.filter(atoms.residues.numbers <= 100).colors[:, 3] < 200).any() or any('Surface' in m.__class__.__name__ and ((getattr(m, 'vertex_colors', None) is not None and (m.vertex_colors[:, 3] < 200).any()) or m.color[3] < 200) for m in models)

request: make it look publiction ready
expected: Pellaeon applies the publication look directly (no 'which option' question): white background plus silhouettes and/or soft lighting.
check: all(c > 0.9 for c in bg) and (session.main_view.silhouette.enabled or session.main_view.lighting.multishadow > 0 or session.main_view.lighting.shadows)

request: clsoe everything
expected: Pellaeon proposes a close command but the safety gate shows a confirmation card and waits for Run/Skip instead of closing on its own.

request: superimpose 7bqy onto 6lu7 so i can compare the N3 binding poses
expected: Runs matchmaker (7bqy moved onto 6lu7) so one atomic structure ends up with a non-identity scene position.
check: any(m.__class__.__name__ == 'AtomicStructure' and not m.position.is_identity() for m in models)
followups: now hide chain C of the moved one so only the 6lu7 inhibitor is visible

request: whats the CA rmsd between chain A of #1 and chain A of #2 as they are right now, dont move anything
expected: Uses the rmsd command (not matchmaker, which would move the model) on the CA atoms of the two alpha chains and reports the value.
check: ^\s*rmsd\b

request: show the hydrogen bonds between the bound glucose and the protein in yellow and show the residues involved
expected: Runs hbonds restricted to the BGC ligand with reveal true, creating a hydrogen bonds pseudobond group with at least one bond.
check: any(m.__class__.__name__ == 'PseudobondGroup' and 'hydrogen' in m.name.lower() and m.num_pseudobonds > 0 for m in models)

request: check for steric clashes between the N3 inhibitor (chain C) and the protease, show them if there are any
expected: Runs the clashes command between chain C and chain A (a refined structure may report zero, so only the command is checked).
check: ^\s*clashes\b

request: show every atom contact within 4 A between chain C (the inhibitor) and chain A as dashed lines
expected: Runs contacts with a 4 A distance-only cutoff and reveal true, producing a contacts pseudobond group with bonds.
check: any(m.__class__.__name__ == 'PseudobondGroup' and 'contact' in m.name.lower() and m.num_pseudobonds > 0 for m in models)

request: surface the protease (chain A only) and color it by hydrophobicity
expected: Creates a molecular surface for chain A and colors it with mlp, so a displayed MolecularSurface has per-vertex colors.
check: any(m.__class__.__name__ == 'MolecularSurface' and m.display and getattr(m, 'vertex_colors', None) is not None for m in models)

request: show me an electrostatic potential surface of the protein so i can see the charge around the sugar site
expected: Runs coulombic on the protein (creating the surface if needed) so a displayed MolecularSurface carries per-vertex colors.
check: any(m.__class__.__name__ == 'MolecularSurface' and m.display and getattr(m, 'vertex_colors', None) is not None for m in models)

request: color it by pLDDT confidence again
expected: Runs color bfactor with the alphafold palette on the ADRB2 AlphaFold model, restoring a multi-color ribbon after the setup painted it white.

request: color helices salmon, strands sky blue and the loops grey
expected: Colors by secondary structure so all helix ribbons share one color and all strand ribbons share a different one.

request: render the coiled coil helices as fat tubes / cylinders instead of ribbons

request: select all the protein residues within 4.5 A of the glucose
